 4-5 years' experience developing mobile application on android and Very strong in object oriented concepts & design patterns with Practical Android coding and debugging experience

 Knowledge of application deployment and Code-signing. 
 Focus on quality & ability to perform code reviews 
 Strong analytical skills for effective problem solving 
 Good communication skills & ability to lead 2-3 member team
